tools.name: browser_attach
tools.result: contextRef and selected tab metadata
tools.description: Attach to the current extension connection and an optional discovered tab, or release an owned context. Never silently selects the active tab. Refs are scoped to this MCP client.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.result: tabs[] with opaque tabRef/url/title/active/windowRef; complete/truncated
tools.description: Discover HTTP(S) page tabs with opaque refs. Without contextRef returns discovery refs for attach; with contextRef returns refs owned by that context. Complete enumeration is required to prove absence.

tools.name: browser_tab_open
tools.result: new tabRef retained even if metadata/load verification times out
tools.description: Open one HTTP(S) URL in a new tab. Returns a pending ref when metadata is not ready. Use tab_get to observe it; never repeat an uncertain open.

tools.name: browser_tab_get
tools.result: tab metadata/generation and unknown-action state; explicit abandon never retries or marks outcome verified
tools.description: Observe one owned tab. resolve explicitly abandons the originating context requestKey with an unknown outcome, expires all old refs for the native tab and returns a fresh ref; it does not prove the earlier action failed.

tools.name: browser_tab_activate
tools.result: active state after activation
tools.description: Activate the owned tab/window and verify the active tab ID. May change desktop focus.

tools.name: browser_tab_close
tools.result: close acknowledgement plus independently enumerated absence
tools.description: Close one owned tab once, then independently verify absence with complete tab enumeration. Never kills the browser process or retries an uncertain close.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.result: acknowledgement, new tabRef after owned navigation, load observation
tools.description: Navigate the owned tab once. Complete mode waits for a document or same-document URL transition and returns a fresh tabRef. None mode requires rediscovery.

tools.name: browser_history
tools.result: Bounded operation data
tools.description: Request back, forward, reload or stop once. Complete mode waits for an observed transition; stop is exempt. Old refs expire. Does not invoke the hardcoded vendor home URL.

tools.name: browser_find_element
tools.result: opaque refs, exact observed matchCount, truncated; strict single reports NOT_FOUND/AMBIGUOUS_TARGET
tools.description: Find exactly one element using CSS, XPath, text or exact attributes within the requested tab/frame/root. Returns opaque elementRef. Zero, multiple and unproven truncated matches are explicit errors.

tools.name: browser_find_elements
tools.result: opaque refs, exact observed matchCount, truncated; strict single reports NOT_FOUND/AMBIGUOUS_TARGET
tools.description: Find a bounded collection in one explicit tab/frame/root. Reports exact or observed count and truncation. Does not cross iframe or shadow boundaries.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.result: bounded flat nodes with refs/parentIndex/tag/label/value/state/rect and truncation
tools.description: Read a bounded flat semantic DOM snapshot with actionable refs, parent indices, state and CSS viewport rectangles. Not a screenshot or an OS accessibility tree.

tools.name: browser_get_element
tools.result: requested fields, unsupportedFields and redaction flags
tools.description: Read only requested text, value, attributes, state and rectangle fields for a live elementRef. Password values are redacted; stale/replaced nodes are never healed.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.result: Bounded operation data
tools.description: Poll an explicit DOM/document condition within one absolute deadline. Distinguishes absent, detached, visibility, enabled state and expected value/text/URL. Does not repeat state-changing actions.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.result: method, acknowledged/verified outcome, documentChanged; no business-success inference
tools.description: Click a live element once. Default dom is synthetic with center hit testing. Optional uipath supports only a single left click and non-atomic native identity guards. ACK alone is not business success; optional verification is exact URL.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.result: method, valueMatch/verified outcome and redacted readback
tools.description: Replace or append text, then separately read back retained value and identity. Default dom uses the native DOM value setter plus input/change; optional uipath uses one text token, options0/4. Password comparison stays in the isolated page. Never automatically retries.

tools.name: browser_set_text
tools.result: Bounded operation data
tools.description: Replace text using the DOM method and separately verify retained value. This is synthetic DOM input, not a trusted OS key sequence.

tools.name: browser_set_checked
tools.result: Bounded operation data
tools.description: Set a checkbox/radio desired state and read it back after dispatch. DOM default; optional native UiPath path. Unsupported radio uncheck is rejected rather than toggled blindly.

tools.name: browser_select_options
tools.result: native HTML select only; exactly one of values/labels
tools.description: Set desired option values or labels on a native HTML select and read back the retained selection. Explicitly rejects ambiguity/disabled options; does not automate arbitrary dropdown widgets.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.result: Bounded operation data
tools.description: Scroll the explicit page/element by/to coordinates or bring an element into view. Returns CSS scroll position. Element refs must match the supplied tab/frame.

tools.name: browser_focus
tools.result: exactly one tabRef or elementRef; tab focus activates owning window
tools.description: Focus either an explicit tab or an element and observe focus. This changes UI focus; it is not key input.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.result: active-tab guarded bounded image artifact; no automatic activation Hidden documents reject with TARGET_NOT_VISIBLE; expired render readiness with CAPTURE_NOT_READY. Target capture errors do not disable other tabs.
tools.description: Capture only the active owned tab viewport, guarding tab/window/document before and after. Returns an artifactRef, not base64 text. Does not auto-activate, use fullpage debugger capture or guarantee external focus race freedom. Requires an explicitly selected active, visible document and bounded two-frame render readiness; never raises a hidden window implicitly.

tools.name: browser_set_attribute
tools.result: Bounded operation data
tools.description: Set an allowlisted DOM attribute and read it back. Rejects event-handler, UiPath/internal and security metadata attributes. Does not imply property/change-event or business semantics.

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.result: synthetic DOM pointer/mouse events; not OS pointer movement
tools.description: Dispatch synthetic pointer/mouse hover events to a visible reachable element. Reports trusted:false; it does not create a real cursor/CSS hover state.

tools.name: browser_drag_and_drop
tools.result: synthetic HTML5 drag events, no OS drag; unsupported if browser/control rejects DataTransfer
tools.description: Dispatch bounded synthetic HTML5 drag/drop events between two live elements in the same frame. Reports trusted:false and event evidence, not an assumed app outcome.

tools.name: browser_frames
tools.result: main frame plus immediate child iframe element refs; no implicit recursive traversal
tools.description: List immediate iframe/frame elements in the explicit frame. Child frames require separate attach before discovery; no implicit cross-frame search.

tools.name: browser_frame_attach
tools.result: explicit iframe ref -> owned child frameRef/document generation
tools.description: Attach to one explicit iframe element through the pinned native selector path. Returns a child frameRef bound to its document plus parent iframe identity; old frame refs expire on reload.

tools.name: browser_text_selection
tools.result: DOM input/textarea selection UTF-16 offsets; SAP native selection route separate
tools.description: Read or set a bounded selection range on supported text inputs/textarea. Password selection text is redacted. Not arbitrary document or rich-text selection.

tools.name: browser_highlight
tools.result: temporary owned outline restored at stop/TTL
tools.description: Start or stop an owned temporary DOM outline with bounded TTL. Cleanup restores only this context highlight and does not overwrite another context highlight.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.result: JSON result; page MAIN world only, explicit side effects; Promise support by bounded bridge job polling

limits.overflow: RESULT_TOO_LARGE after script dispatch: no retry; unknown block remains until explicit abandon.

tools.description: Run one validated function expression in the page MAIN world, optionally with an element and bounded JSON input. Awaits Promise via tickets. Result<=64KiB/depth16. Throw, identity loss or oversized result after dispatch may have mutated; observe and explicitly resolve, never replay.

tools.name: browser_extract_table
tools.result: bounded rows/columns and per-page partial outcomes; pagination explicit only
tools.description: Read bounded HTML table/custom row columns, optionally with explicit root/next pagination locators and page/row limits. Returns partial rows on failure. No SAP or vendor opaque extraction-schema parity.

tools.name: browser_table_cell
tools.result: HTML table cell ref (zero-based DOM row/cell indices)
tools.description: Get a live cell elementRef by row/column index from an explicit HTML table. Not a virtual/SAP grid adapter.

tools.name: browser_tree
tools.result: HTML ARIA tree only; no generic SAP activity parity
tools.description: Read or expand/collapse explicit ARIA tree nodes, with an optional strict label path. Only supported DOM/ARIA semantics; no claim of universal tree widget or SAP support.

tools.name: browser_calendar_select
tools.result: native input[type=date] only; custom/SAP calendars unavailable
tools.description: Set and separately verify a native HTML input[type=date] value. Rejects application restoration; no arbitrary calendar widget automation.

tools.name: browser_form_read
tools.result: bounded HTML controls, refs and values; password fields redacted
tools.description: Read bounded input/textarea/select controls and live refs inside an explicit form/root. Password values stay redacted. Reports truncation.

tools.name: browser_form_fill
tools.result: sequential desired-state steps, partial failures, no submit or rollback
tools.description: Fill explicit fields sequentially using verified text/check/select primitives. Returns completed steps and partial failure; never auto-submits, rolls back or repeats earlier writes.

tools.name: browser_close_popup
tools.result: explicit DOM close control only; not browser/OS/JS dialogs
tools.description: Find exactly one explicitly supplied close-control locator and click it once. ACK does not imply an arbitrary popup disappeared; no generic dialog backend.

tools.name: browser_network_wait
tools.result: Arm before trigger, wait for continuous quiet among requests observed since arm, cancel/TTL/finally stop; no claim about pre-existing requests.
tools.description: Arm before triggering requests, wait for continuous quiet among requests started since arm, or cancel. Owns one native monitor/tab, bounded TTL/finally cleanup. Does not know pre-existing requests or app readiness.

tools.name: browser_events
tools.result: bounded event queue, nextCursor/droppedCount, no arbitrary event serialization
tools.description: Subscribe/poll/unsubscribe an owned bounded DOM event queue in one explicit frame/target. TTL and droppedCount are explicit; password/printable keys are redacted. Not native OS recording or a key sender.

tools.name: browser_wait_new_tab
tools.result: baseline + exact URL new-tab correlation; no opener guarantee
tools.description: Arm a complete baseline plus exact URL, then wait/cancel. Correlation is baseline-and-URL only, not opener identity. Multiple matching tabs are ambiguous; no guessing.

tools.name: browser_cookies
tools.result: current document origin visible cookies only; no HttpOnly/profile-wide restore
tools.description: List/set/delete only document.cookie visible in the current origin/path. No HttpOnly access, profile export/restore or unrelated-origin cookie reads. Mutations require matching cookie path boundaries.

tools.name: browser_window
tools.result: native owning-window metadata/activate/maximize only
tools.description: Read owning window/active state or activate/maximize the explicit tab window. Maximize reports only native acknowledgement; no restore/minimize/process/launch backend.

tools.name: browser_image_artifact
tools.result: owner-scoped image metadata/bounded read/export within artifact output root; never arbitrary path
tools.description: Inspect/read/save an owned temporary image. Read adds a separate MCP image block only if<=384KiB. Save accepts a safe basename under managed work storage, never an arbitrary path or overwrite. Exports expire with context/TTL.

tools.name: browser_press_keys
tools.description: Send a bounded sequence of page-level key events to one paired tab; keys are not trusted hardware input.

tools.name: browser_semantic_query
tools.description: Find candidates by local Ollama natural-language ranking or exact Chrome accessibility role/name filters. Returns observations only.

tools.name: browser_dialog
tools.description: Arm and control one exact JavaScript dialog independently of the blocked page-action queue. Policies are explicit; no implicit dismissal.

tools.name: browser_file_picker
tools.description: Assign configured, staged files to an exact HTML input[type=file] selected by one intercepted chooser event. OS pickers are unsupported.

tools.name: browser_download
tools.description: Start an explicitly owned HTTP(S) download and read/cancel it by returned opaque ref. Arbitrary user-click downloads are not correlated.

tools.name: browser_launch
tools.description: Start and manage a configured isolated Chrome profile. Initial readiness is process-owned but unpaired and grants no browser refs.

tools.name: system_clipboard
tools.description: Read or replace plain text in the current Windows interactive session clipboard. Reads never occur during readiness checks.

tools.name: browser_visual_find
tools.description: Find same-scale pixel templates in owner-scoped screenshot artifacts. Results are observations, never click targets.

tools.name: browser_ocr
tools.description: Recognize text in one owner-scoped screenshot using an installed Windows OCR language. Text boxes are observations only.

tools.name: browser_accessibility_audit
tools.description: Run a bounded axe-core WCAG scan through a fixed asynchronous isolated-world ticket; results are automated observations, not a conformance claim.
